newsitem.title: USA: US Senate panel approves air ticket tax extension.
newsitem.headline: US Senate panel approves air ticket tax extension.

text.p: The Senate Finance Committee Wednesday approved a bill to reimpose the 10 percent U.S. airline ticket tax through Sept 30, 1997. The tax expired at the end of 1996.
The bill now goes to the full Senate. The House Ways and Means Committee is working on an identical bill.
The bill, which was approved by voice vote, also gives the Treasury Department authority to transfer $1.2 billion in tax revenues sent to the Treasury by the airlines last month.
Under current law, the Treasury does not have the authority to transfer the money from its general funds to the Airport and Airways Trust Fund.
The bill also modifies Treasury regulations to prevent airlines from delaying payment of the tax.
The committee acted after the Treasury and Transportation Departments said the trust fund would run out of money soon unless the tax was reimposed.
